A done snapshot takes poke and increments context. A sent event retains at=5 while raised and done events lack at. Tags are asserted as an array with hasTag behaviour. Eventless loops under and over maxIterations 1000 settle and fail respectively. The graph walk passes at four edges and refuses at three, with a separate ten-self-loop edge control. All nine tests passed in this independent run.
